scope: For an open subset U of finite-dimensional Euclidean space R^n, every continuous injection U -> R^n has open image (invariance of domain).
boundary: Theorem 2B.3, printed p.172. No connectedness, compactness, differentiability or nonemptiness is needed for the theorem itself; n=0 is trivially valid. The lower-target-dimension consequence requires a nonempty source and is a separate project adapter using inclusion into a proper linear subspace. The domain is open in Euclidean space; boundary half-charts and arbitrary subsets do not satisfy this hypothesis. Corollary 2B.4 is not separately imported: its compact-source/connected-target surjectivity claim requires nonempty source, omitted in the displayed statement.
limitations: Nonempty open-domain lower-dimension adapter is separate from the imported theorem.
Do not transfer the theorem to boundary half-charts without further argument.
Graphify unavailable; deterministic adapter validation is independent.
